summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Not run: tests and Black (Black is not installed), so verification was by reading only. Black-style formatting was checked by hand. Changes are uncommitted.
